title: Offscreen item atlas transitioned to COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL but rendered in GENERAL, and the render transition does not wait for the previous batch's attachment writes
expected_finding: item_atlas is moved GENERAL -> COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL but vkCmdBeginRendering uses it as GENERAL, and later barriers give oldLayout GENERAL / COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL that do not match its layout; the second batch's barrier has srcStage FRAGMENT_SHADER / srcAccess SHADER_READ, so its layout transition and attachment writes are not ordered after the first batch's attachment writes (write-after-write)
